summary: FIFA / EA Sports football simulation entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: FIFA 18
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC version with final patch and World Cup update if available

emulation.notes: Native PC route; console versions need original hardware or compatibility only for comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC Frostbite build at final patch level

primary.version: FIFA 18 PC version with the 2018 FIFA World Cup update if installed
primary.why: The Windows/PS4/Xbox One Frostbite branch is the high-fidelity route for FIFA 18, and PC gives the cleanest capture/settings path. The Switch, PS3, and Xbox 360 releases are useful historical routes but are not the fidelity target.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned PC copy through EA app/Origin if still available, install the final patch and World Cup update if present, and record roster patch, online-service availability, and whether Ultimate Team/service modes are accessible.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster route exists. Treat live/online modes as time-sensitive and document delisted or retired services.
